basic_info.description: Experience sophisticated San Francisco living at its finest. This beautifully remodeled residence offers approximately 1,580 sq. ft. of refined interiors, including two spacious bedrooms, an office alcove, and two luxurious bathrooms. Period details such as parquet floors and elegant ceiling and wall moldings have been thoughtfully preserved, blending timeless charm with modern comfort. The living room captures sweeping views of Downtown San Francisco and features a decorative fireplace with custom built-ins. The chef's kitchen delights with two-tone cabinetry, quartz countertops, double ovens, an induction cooktop, and a bar-top peninsula that flows seamlessly into the expansive dining room. The primary suite exudes a resort-like ambiance with a custom closet, dual vanities, and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower. An informal two-unit HOA shares expenses equally, and the home includes one-car parking and an exclusive-use garden for private outdoor enjoyment.
